_about: Public-domain John Tillotson (1630-1694, Archbishop of Canterbury, the most read English preacher of the next century) for the Word Hoard: The Works of Dr. John Tillotson, with Thomas Birch's Life of the author (London: J. F. Dove for Richard Priestley, 1820, 10 vols): vols 4-10 clean from CCEL, vols 1-2 raw Internet Archive OCR of the same 1820 edition; vol. 3 pending. Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 11 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
